mechanism: Ginkgo biloba may inhibit CYP3A4 and CYP2C19, potentially increasing clobazam plasma concentrations and its active metabolite N-desmethylclobazam, while also possessing mild antiplatelet properties that could theoretically increase bleeding risk.
action: Monitor for increased clobazam adverse effects (dizziness, ataxia, sedation) and consider clobazam dose adjustment; counsel patient to report any unusual bleeding or bruising.
